scope: Continued browser workflow exploration after the first review, focusing on edits during playback, repeated placements, reservations, persistence, and offline restart.
methods: Generated WAV recordings through real browser audio transport
Controlled YouTube API fixture for reproducible queue ordering
limitations: Subjective listening, physical devices, and live YouTube availability were not assessed.
Reload restores the queue and selected recording; playback restarts that recording when explicitly resumed.

fixes.trigger: Delete the active placement of A from [A, B, A], then refresh.
fixes.result: The deleted placement cannot match the later A. Playback and the existing queue remain intact, with an explanation.

fixes.trigger: Edit, reserve a recording, refresh, or reload during tanda-only listening.
fixes.result: The queue retains its selected tanda scope and does not expand into the entire program.

fixes.trigger: Refresh the upcoming queue with pending reservations.
fixes.result: Reservations retain their cancellation controls and placement identity.

fixes.trigger: Cancel or reorder a reservation while unrelated edits are unreflected.
fixes.result: The stale-queue warning remains visible until those edits are reflected.

fixes.trigger: Cancel a reservation after deleting its placement or parent tanda.
fixes.result: The reservation is removable without deleting a different recording or requiring its former parent.

fixes.trigger: Swap duplicate placements of the same recording.
fixes.result: Queue freshness includes occurrence identity and detects the change.

fixes.trigger: Undo a group edit after deleting recordings from the library.
fixes.result: Surviving recordings retain their original placement identities.

fixes.trigger: Rename the current tanda and refresh.
fixes.result: Playback and queue labels update without restarting the recording.

check_harness_corrections: An earlier continuous-audio attempt incorrectly required playback time to survive reload; that expectation was removed because reload restores the recording rather than its timestamp.

A later continuous-audio attempt stopped after 14 successful edit checkpoints because an unconditional pause click restarted an ended recording. The replacement checks transport state before pausing; final-endpoint behavior also passed separately in three browser/device projects.
Initial offline checks used an async wait predicate that treated its unresolved Promise as truthy. The corrected activation helper passed both offline tests.
The repeated-title endpoint check now waits for loading to finish and verifies Recording 3 / 3 before seeking; the title A alone cannot distinguish the first and final placement.
